usage: What changed since the previous snapshot, which is the delta the daily report's 'last ~24 hours' framing needs. Compared against the player_index.json present when this run started, so the window is one snapshot interval (roughly six hours), not exactly 24 hours: previous_snapshot_at says when. injury_changes is the highest-value list and is sorted with Jason X players first; direction is new, changed or cleared. became_available are players dropped by a rival and now addable. became_rostered are players claimed, which is how a target you were considering disappears. changed_team is a trade or a waiver move between teams. comparable is false on a first run or when no previous snapshot was present, in which case every list is empty and absence of change must not be reported as stability.
